title: ServerConfig Debug impl redacts secret_key — good
description: src/config.rs:50-58. The manual Debug impl for ServerConfig replaces secret_key with '[REDACTED]'. This prevents accidental secret exposure in log output. Similarly, DeliveryRow (src/delivery.rs:23-35) redacts private_key_pem in its Debug impl. These are correct and worth defending — they should not be removed in any refactor.
